Five reviewed team scorecards matched to MLB game records

Source: R/reviewed_scorecards.R
reviewed_scorecards.Rd

A collection of 179 plate appearances from Arizona, St. Louis, Minnesota, Cleveland, and New York Mets scorecards. Each included card covers every plate appearance for one team in one game. Event identities and batting counts were checked against independently retrieved MLB feeds on October 25, 2026. The original Twins example remains available separately.

Usage

reviewed_scorecards

Format

A data frame with 179 rows and 18 columns:

game_id

Character MLB game identifier.

team

Character batting team name from MLB.

player

Character batter name from MLB.

inning

Character inning number; rows follow card layout.

play

Character reviewed canonical event label.

confidence

Numeric score retained from the saved app export; not a probability that the reviewed label is correct.

needs_review

Logical, FALSE for all accepted rows.

game_date

Date of the game.

side

Character, home or away.

opponent

Character opponent name.

batter_id

Integer MLB batter identifier.

event_id

Character MLB atBatIndex, unique within each game.

source_result

Character saved-result identifier and child card if applicable.

source_cell

Character one-based card row/column identifier.

source_play

Character label retained from the original saved export.

source_needs_review

Logical flag reconstructed from saved app confidence/review indicators and its cached label disagreement.

reference_play

Character canonical label independently derived from the retrieved MLB event.

review_note

Character review decision or correction explanation.

Source

Local dAImond Inning saved results and MLB Stats API game feeds, retrieved October 25, 2026. Source IDs, feed URLs and SHA-256 hashes are in data-raw/verification-manifest.json in the source repository. The original app files are not required to rebuild the R data from its source CSV. MLB feed URL pattern: https://statsapi.mlb.com/api/v1.1/game/746804/feed/live. Official counting totals used for validation are installed in inst/extdata/reviewed_game_totals.csv and reviewed_player_totals.csv.

Details

Accepted games are 746804 (Twins, April 29, 2024), 823644 (Mets, April 11, 2026), 825071 (Diamondbacks, June 15, 2026), 823774 (Guardians, June 17, 2026), and 822782 (Cardinals, July 31, 2026). Only the named team's side is included. There are 49 distinct game/team/player combinations.

Review included card images, unique batter/inning/description matching, complete event coverage, and player/team counting totals. Ten saved labels differ from their reviewed values. Force outs where the batter reaches first are fielder choices, not ordinary groundouts. Original saved labels remain in source_play. Saved exports may already contain contextual corrections; label agreement is not an independent model-accuracy estimate.

Incomplete cards, extra detections, duplicate processing runs, unresolved game assignments, and a card/official hit-versus-error conflict were excluded. The data contain no complete season and do not establish comparative team strength or a causal effect. Base-out transitions for RE24 are in the companion dataset reviewed_base_out, which joins by game_id and event_id. Do not combine this dataset with twins_scorecard_2024 without deduplicating the overlapping Twins game.

Examples

str(reviewed_scorecards)
#> 'data.frame':	179 obs. of  18 variables:
#>  $ game_id            : chr  "825071" "825071" "825071" "825071" ...
#>  $ team               : chr  "Arizona Diamondbacks" "Arizona Diamondbacks" "Arizona Diamondbacks" "Arizona Diamondbacks" ...
#>  $ player             : chr  "Ketel Marte" "Ketel Marte" "Ketel Marte" "Ketel Marte" ...
#>  $ inning             : chr  "1" "3" "5" "7" ...
#>  $ play               : chr  "flyout" "groundout" "groundout" "single" ...
#>  $ confidence         : num  0.949 0.947 0.949 0.951 0.948 ...
#>  $ needs_review       : logi  FALSE FALSE FALSE FALSE FALSE FALSE ...
#>  $ game_date          : Date, format: "2026-06-15" "2026-06-15" ...
#>  $ side               : chr  "home" "home" "home" "home" ...
#>  $ opponent           : chr  "Los Angeles Angels" "Los Angeles Angels" "Los Angeles Angels" "Los Angeles Angels" ...
#>  $ batter_id          : int  606466 606466 606466 606466 672695 672695 672695 672695 682998 682998 ...
#>  $ event_id           : chr  "5" "23" "40" "56" ...
#>  $ source_result      : chr  "09a49fc97cd5" "09a49fc97cd5" "09a49fc97cd5" "09a49fc97cd5" ...
#>  $ source_cell        : chr  "r1c1" "r1c3" "r1c5" "r1c7" ...
#>  $ source_play        : chr  "flyout" "groundout" "groundout" "single" ...
#>  $ source_needs_review: logi  FALSE FALSE FALSE FALSE FALSE FALSE ...
#>  $ reference_play     : chr  "flyout" "groundout" "groundout" "single" ...
#>  $ review_note        : chr  "Matched to the MLB event." "Matched to the MLB event." "Matched to the MLB event." "Matched to the MLB event." ...
batting <- calculate_batting_stats(reviewed_scorecards)
aggregate(PA ~ game_id + team, batting, sum)
#>   game_id                 team PA
#> 1  825071 Arizona Diamondbacks 35
#> 2  823774  Cleveland Guardians 33
#> 3  746804      Minnesota Twins 35
#> 4  823644        New York Mets 41
#> 5  822782  St. Louis Cardinals 35
